item.title: Big eGift Card Sale!
item.description:
Looking for that perfect gift for a special someone? You’ve come to the right place!

An eGift Card from Paul Brown, CMT is a thoughtful gift that shows you really care about your special someone (even if that special someone is you!)

Here’s the deal

  • Buy 10 or more hours of bodywork, receive a 40% discount
  • Buy 5 to 9 hours, 35% discount
  • Buy 2 to 4 hours, 25% discount
  • Buy a single hour, 15% discount

That’s pretty great deal!
